intro.text: A nation on the eastern edge of the Fjordell Empire.

description.text: Svorden lies to its north, Fjorden to the northwest, Hraggen to the west and Hrovell to the southwest. Its eastern side faces the coast and unclaimed desert stretches to the south. A large river marks most of its northern and western frontier, and another river runs across the south.
As a part of the empire it follows Shu-Dereth. Unlike Svorden, Geant has lost its sense of nationhood: its own language has disappeared and its people now speak Fjordell.
